# Dataset card: `chomp4_n1000`

*Auto-generated by `overthink generate`; do not edit by hand. Regenerate instead.*

All P-positions (a, b, c, d) of 4-row Chomp with first row a <= 1000. Restricting to a <= 500 gives the 4,316,097 positions used in the author's 4xn Chomp paper.

## Game

**4-row Chomp: P-positions.** Row lengths a >= b >= c >= d >= 0 with a >= 1. Square (0,0) is poisoned and cannot be taken. A move picks a square (i, j) != (0,0) inside the position and removes it with every square (i', j') where i' >= i and j' >= j. The player unable to move loses, so (1,0,0,0) is a P-position.

## Contents

Every P-position with a <= max_a (and c <= max_c). Positions not listed, within those bounds, are N-positions. For each (b, c, d) at most one a gives a P-position.

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| `max_a` | `1000` |

| | |
|---|---|
| Rows | 35,029,679 |
| File size (Parquet, zstd) | 50.1 MB |
| Sort order | a, b, c, d |
| Schema version | 1.0 |

## Schema

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | UInt32 | length of row 1 (the row with the poisoned square) |
| `b` | UInt32 | length of row 2 |
| `c` | UInt32 | length of row 3 |
| `d` | UInt32 | length of row 4 |
